description: Poster of Maria Chabot's photograph, with a boarder of white. Georgia O'Keeffe on the back of a motorcycle holding on to a male friend ( Maurice Grosser) who is driving.  She is turning back looking towards the camera, in an expansive New Mexican landscape.
title: Poster of Chabot's photo: Georgia O'Keeffe Hitching a Ride to Abiquiu with Maurice Grosser
